title: GB constraints — Neura Atlas snapshot
about: Open GB layers from the Neura Constraint Atlas: SO-flagged wind turn-down by BM unit, NESO day-ahead boundary forecasts on ETYS lines, interconnector outturn and the GB wind curtailment index. Every figure names its method; every source key is open; see docs/ATLAS_BRIDGE.md.

turndown_window.rule: settlement periods starting at or after the request time minus 7 days
turndown_window.ahead_note: Periods that had not started at the request time hold only the acceptances issued by then; their figures can rise in a later snapshot.
